submit_steps: Branch, don't fork. You are a collaborator, so push a branch to this repo and open the PR from it against main.

Build and test locally (Linux only). The build needs GHC 9.6.7, cabal 3.16, python3, rsync and the Cardano system libraries (libsodium, secp256k1, blst). Scoring also needs valgrind. setup.sh uses GNU sed -i, so it fails on macOS. On a Mac, edit there and build on a Linux machine, or let CI build it.
Open the PR and read the result. Opening the PR, and every later push to it, starts the Submission workflow. A new push cancels the run in progress for that PR.

After the merge. The maintainer merges PRs one at a time. The merge starts the Promote workflow on main, which takes about 20 minutes with warm caches (longer after a cold rebuild). It makes two independent runs, each on its own fresh pool and seed. challenges.summary: Make cardano-ledger decode real mainnet Conway transactions in fewer instructions, without changing what it decodes or what it rejects. The editable code is the src/ of the decoding stack: cardano-ledger-binary (the Decoder monad, Annotator, coders, primitives), cardano-ledger-core and the era packages from Shelley to Conway (the per-field instances, MaryValue, BabbageTxOut, the Conway tx body...).
challenges.title: Cardano ledger: faster Conway CBOR decoding (cardano-ledger, Haskell)
